sources.limitations: Seven irregularly spaced poses, selected six progressive rear-right collapse keys. Final body and muzzle rest low with limbs relaxed on side; back planes remain visible. Approved charcoal plates and ember seams retained. Unequal row layout cropped explicitly; late keys appear somewhat larger, owner review for anatomical scale in motion.

Twelve poses in 4/2/3/3 layout. Top ready duplicates excluded; both hit clips select a clear lifted-neck recoil and braced recovery from later stronger keys. Rear dorsal plates retained. Some keys resemble a bark/lunge, owner review for hit readability. Authored component centres isolate the irregular layout without cutting overlapping pose bounding boxes; no body reconstruction.

Corrected rear motion: four subtle idle keys, five selected bound keys showing forepaw reach/contact and airborne hind extension, five attack keys from head-lowering to jaw-open lunge and rear recovery. Near-duplicate run key 7 and extra mouth-flame key 14 excluded. Gait is a candidate for owner timing review, not a six-key alternating-stride claim.

Roomier 2x3 correction separates all six rear hounds. Four low forepaw-planted resistance keys selected; standing entry keys omitted. Rear charcoal back and ember seams retained. Bounding boxes overlap across row boundaries but disjoint opaque components are isolated without body edits. Owner review for hunched-loop motion.

Nine poses supplied instead of six. Front-right chest and muzzle anatomy retained; selected progressive lowering then side-lying endpoint. Body intact, canine only; angular charcoal plates and orange seams match approved Covenant source. Flame tail persists as identity. Owner review for front-angle strength and timing.

Ten poses arranged 4/3/3. Clear neck recoil and stronger animal balance loss; heavy keys reselected to start and finish ready. Forelegs lift in recoil despite grounded-paw prompt; remains quadruped anatomy. Some purple matte spill within dark plates; local keying and approved palette gate applied, owner review for pigment continuity.

Sixteen motion keys: four subtle idle poses, five usable front canine bound keys, six jaw-open lunge/attack keys. Rear-turn run key 7 excluded. Run shows reach, plant, gathered and airborne legs; five-key loop is a candidate, not a certified alternating gait. Pink ground shadows key out locally; purple matte spill remains a style-review limitation.

Seven irregular front guard poses. Four planted/braced effort keys selected for resistance loop; entry-ready and recovered poses omitted. Intact animal, no shield/weapon added. Claw marks and ember intensity vary slightly; pose loop and pigment continuity remain owner-review.
